{{Top|leg}}
The '''Warden Droid''' was a type of [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] that was specialized for patrolling [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] detention centers. They were programmed to capture escaping prisoners and to put down riots through nonlethal means, so that punishment could meted out to the prisoners by flesh-and-blood guards. They were tall and angular, with a thin body and long, spindly arms that were fitted with [[stun claw]]s. Some were used in an Imperial prison on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].
